decisions.rationale: No NOA or T4 for the most recent tax year is on file; the pay stub and letter alone do not meet the required document for a salaried applicant.
Chequing balance $172,094 with a stable history since March covers the $148,000 down payment and closing costs; the $3,360 e-transfer is small relative to the balance.
Ironbridge Valuation Ltd. (on panel), dated 2026-05-29, values at $743,000 against a $740,000 price with no conditions.
Permanent full-time since 2017, probation completed, on letterhead, signed, dated 2026-06-09.

GDS about 37.4% and TDS about 44.4% with full condo fees marginally exceeds the 44% limit (about 40.7% if condo fees were half-counted); policy does not state the condo fee method, credit score 764 is strong.
